modules.module_title: Prepare for installation and integration of control panel

pcs.pc_description: identify accurately the work requirements and delivery time schedule from authorized sources
carry out micro-level planning for installation and commissioning activities
clarify doubts by referring to design, drawing, job instructions and work manuals before going to the site
identify tools and tackles required at the site
ensure availability of control panel and tools required for installation at the site before visiting the site
ensure adequacy of working space, access and maintenance facilities at the site and ensure panel fixing is proper
inspect and determine any transit damage of goods and equipment
prepare transit damage report accurately in the presence of customer representative and proceed as per organization SOP
ensure required tools are available to carry out the installation
prepare a physical verification of the equipment and accessories that are available at site as per the check list
ensure that all the devices in the panel are dust free
check the internal panel wiring and ensure that it is in accordance with the design drawing
check insulation of internal panel wiring and devices within the panel
check if batteries and chargers have been assembled in accordance with manufactures recommended procedures
verify the electrical conductors sizes and capacity for installation according to specifications
ensure that panel is positioned as prescribed, following safety norms
inspect the connection to socket outlets, switches and protective conductors
verify and / or perform settings of various components/sub-systems of the control panels supplied as per design and customer requirements
ensure that fuses, switches and other protective devices are labeled correctly
prepare ground and earth the panels
check for various voltage levels on charged panel, danger and warning notices, if necessary
follow company approved standard procedures in erection and commissioning process
use the wiring diagram to validate the accuracy of the installation to meet the specifications
ensure that applicable local electrical codes and standards are used
ensure that no installation damage has occurred, if there is damage to the panel while installing, prepare report and proceed as per organization SOP to rectify the damage
determine the process for testing the control panel and identify requirements for connections to the customer system, by referring to the organization SOP for panel testing and instruction therein
ensure cable ends, glands and terminators are properly processed
ensure end to end continuity of all the cables
ensure control panel is grounded properly
ensure continuity of all the fuses
test MCB functioning to ensure it is according to panel design
check the electrical load of the control panel and verify that it is within the specification
check control systems interlocks, record any faults and create rectification list
check each digital control point by comparing the command at the control panel and status of the devices that it controls
perform continuity check, insulation resistance, functions of all devices after completion of installation of all devices
check the functional testing information to be carried out in accompaniment with client and record and document the same
prepare work site test report and document for future use

modules.module_title: Integrate control panel with customer system

pcs.pc_description: interact with commissioning engineer in order to understand customer system integration requirements and work schedule
check the design/ drawing of the customer system to extract relevant information for integration
check the location of the customer system and plan for cable routing and related work, ensuring safety and efficiency
check with customers engineer or authorized person for planned integration work and ensure availability of the system
check shutdown requirement for the integration work then coordinate with the customer representative and ensure availability
perform the required installation and or connection to the customer system , preferably in the presence of a customer representative
ensure that cable gland mounting , cable end terminations and labelling are properly done
check the cleanliness of customer system and ensure that the work area is free from any packing material or debris etc.
prepare a report of integration work performed in a format specified by the commissioning engineer
rectify any identified errors and retest to verify correct operation, if the fault persists, report to the engineer and seek guidance
check that the required tools are available to carry out the commissioning process
prepare the user acceptance test performance sheet in the format agreed upon by the engineer and customer
apply the control inputs from the panel or from the customer system and ecord resultant readings and control outputs in the specified observation sheet

maintain record of damaged components as received, damaged during installation and damaged during testing
ensure compliance with health and safety guidelines and rules

modules.module_title: Work as per the organisational team environment

pcs.pc_description: identify team objectives and goals, team members by name, their role and responsibilities, greet them appropriately and respond to their greetings
comply with organisation’s policies and procedures for working with team members within and outside the organisation—especially related to privacy, confidentiality and security
work as per the environment to build trust and mutual respect
participate in decision making by providing facts and figures, give / accept constructive suggestions, take initiatives to help team members arrive at workable decisions and meet the goals
accept decisions professionally and support even if they do not match suggestions and personal views

let team members know in good time if commitments cannot be carried out, explaining the reasons, and provide alternate solutions, if any; let the team lead know about this

act in the interest of the team and the organisation, take initiative to correct the wrong, seek help or escalate if needed to ensure that things do not ‘fall through the gap’ and team goals are achieved
